description: This file defines an abstract interface class 'VideoFrameBuffer' within the 'cuttlefish::webrtc_streaming' namespace. The class provides virtual getter methods for accessing video frame properties such as dimensions, strides, data pointers, and data sizes, but contains no implementation details.

classes.name: VideoFrameBuffer
classes.description: An abstract class representing a buffer for a video frame, providing methods to access dimensions, strides, data buffers, and data sizes.

methods.name: ~VideoFrameBuffer
methods.description: Destructor of VideoFrameBuffer, default virtual destructor.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the video frame.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the video frame.

methods.name: StrideY
methods.description: Returns the stride (bytes per row) for the Y plane.

methods.name: StrideU
methods.description: Returns the stride (bytes per row) for the U plane.

methods.name: StrideV
methods.description: Returns the stride (bytes per row) for the V plane.

methods.name: DataY
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer for the Y plane.

methods.name: DataU
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer for the U plane.

methods.name: DataV
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer for the V plane.

methods.name: DataSizeY
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the Y plane data buffer.

methods.name: DataSizeU
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the U plane data buffer.

methods.name: DataSizeV
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the V plane data buffer.
